verdict.rationale: Docs describe files/journal entries as real local files (synced Finder folder, Markdown notes in a 'Mind' folder), suggesting some local-first storage, but the core search/indexing/agent stack is cloud-hosted (remote MCP server at mcp.poly.app, OAuth-gated, server-side parsing/transcribing/indexing) — and a hands-on community reviewer explicitly notes 'your service, by nature, is reading and analyzing all of my files using a remote server,' directly contradicting a fully offline, locally-owned workflow. Missing for 10: no documentation of an offline mode, no evidence local files remain fully functional/searchable without the cloud service, and no rebuttal to the community's remote-dependency observation.
